    71	      (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op Y))

    73	      (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op Y)) =

    17	The declarations here are independent of the Abel transformation and make no representability
    18	or quotient assertion.
    19	-/

    21	set_option autoImplicit false

    31	/-! ## Reduction to affine tests -/
    32	
    33	/-- A sieve on a scheme is etale-covering if its pullback to every member of the canonical
    34	affine open cover is etale-covering. -/
    35	theorem mem_etaleTopology_of_pullback_affine {T : Scheme.{u}} (S : Sieve T)
    36	    (h : ∀ (j : T.affineCover.I₀), S.pullback (T.affineCover.f j) ∈
    37	      Scheme.etaleTopology (T.affineCover.X j)) :
    38	    S ∈ Scheme.etaleTopology T := by
    39	  have hcov : (Sieve.generate (Presieve.ofArrows T.affineCover.X T.affineCover.f))
    40	      ∈ Scheme.etaleTopology T := by
    41	    apply Scheme.zariskiTopology_le_etaleTopology
    42	    exact Scheme.mem_grothendieckTopology_iff.mpr
    43	      ⟨T.affineCover, Sieve.le_generate _⟩
    44	  refine Scheme.etaleTopology.transitive hcov S ?_
    45	  rintro Y g ⟨V, a, b, ⟨j⟩, rfl⟩
    46	  rw [Sieve.pullback_comp]
    47	  exact Scheme.etaleTopology.pullback_stable a (h j)
    48	
    49	/-- To prove local surjectivity on the big etale site, it suffices to produce an etale cover
    50	with local lifts over every affine test scheme. -/
    51	theorem isLocallySurjective_etale_of_affine
    52	    {F G : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : F ⟶ G)
    53	    (h : ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y] (s : G.obj (op Y)),
    54	      ∃ (cover : Y.Cover.{u} (Scheme.precoverage @Etale)),
    55	        ∀ j : cover.I₀, ∃ x : F.obj (op (cover.X j)),
    56	          f.app (op (cover.X j)) x = G.map (cover.f j).op s) :
    57	    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.etaleTopology f where
    58	  imageSieve_mem {U} s := by
    59	    apply mem_etaleTopology_of_pullback_affine
    60	    intro j
    61	    rw [Presheaf.pullback_imageSieve]
    62	    obtain ⟨cover, hcover⟩ :=
    63	      h (U.affineCover.X j) (G.map (U.affineCover.f j).op s)
    64	    refine (Scheme.mem_grothendieckTopology_iff (P := @Etale)).mpr ⟨cover, ?_⟩
    65	    rintro Y g ⟨i⟩
    66	    exact hcover i

    68	/-! ## Covers induced by affine etale presentations -/
    69	
    70	/-- The spectrum of the carrier of an algebraic etale cover is a singleton etale cover of
    71	the spectrum of the base algebra. -/
    72	noncomputable def etaleSchemeCover {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    73	    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) :
    74	    (Spec (.of A)).Cover (Scheme.precoverage @Etale) :=
    75	  Scheme.Cover.mkOfCovers PUnit (fun _ => Spec (.of E.Carrier))
    76	    (fun _ => Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier)))
    77	    (fun x => by
    78	      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := E.comap_surjective x
    79	      exact ⟨PUnit.unit, y, hy⟩)
    80	    (fun _ => by
    81	      rw [HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)]
    82	      exact RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance)
    83	
    84	/-! ## Honestification of affine PicEt classes -/
    85	
    86	namespace PicEtAff
    87	
    88	/-- `mapAlg` agrees with the instance-based affine restriction map when the underlying ring
    89	homomorphism is the chosen `A`-algebra structure on `B`. -/
    90	theorem mapAlg_eq_map_of_toRingHom_eq_algebraMap
    91	    {k A B : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [CommRing B]
    92	    [Algebra k B] [Algebra A B] [IsScalarTower k A B]
    93	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (phi : A →ₐ[k] B)
    94	    (hphi : phi.toRingHom = algebraMap A B) (a : PicEtAff C A) :
    95	    PicEtAff.mapAlg C phi a = PicEtAff.map C B a := by
    96	  have hAlg : phi.toRingHom.toAlgebra = (inferInstance : Algebra A B) :=
    97	    Algebra.algebra_ext _ _ fun r => by
    98	      change phi r = algebraMap A B r
    99	      exact DFunLike.congr_fun hphi r
   100	  unfold PicEtAff.mapAlg
   101	  subst hAlg
   102	  rfl
   103	
   104	/-- Restricting an affine PicEt presentation along the map to its own cover carrier produces
   105	the honest class represented by its descent datum. -/
   106	theorem mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self
   107	    {k A : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   108	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   109	    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (x : descentClasses C E) :
   110	    PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   111	        (PicEtAff.mk C E x)
   112	      = PicEtAff.unit C E.Carrier
   113	          (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) := by
   114	  rw [mapAlg_eq_map_of_toRingHom_eq_algebraMap C _ rfl]
   115	  exact PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_self C E x
   116	
   117	end PicEtAff

   119	/-- On affine tests, restricting a `picEt` class to the carrier of one of its plus
   120	presentations agrees with the `picEt` unit of the corresponding honest relative Picard
   121	class. -/
   122	theorem picEtMap_eq_relPicToPicEt_of_affineRepresentative
   123	    {k A : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   124	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   125	    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
   126	    (lam : picEt C (overSpec k A)) (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A)
   127	    (x : descentClasses C E)
   128	    (h : picEtAffineEquiv C A lam = PicEtAff.mk C E x) :
   129	    picEtMap C
   130	        (Over.overSpecMap ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)) lam
   131	      = relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k E.Carrier)
   132	          (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) := by
   133	  apply (picEtAffineEquiv C E.Carrier).injective
   134	  rw [picEtAffineEquiv_naturality, h,
   135	    picEtAffineEquiv_relPicToPicEt,
   136	    PicEtAff.mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self]

   138	end

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AdmissibleAbelEtaleSurjectiveSite
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Etale covers from pointwise prime lifts
    10	
    11	This file packages the cover used in the affine callback for admissible Abel
    12	surjectivity.  Starting from a singleton affine etale cover, every prime of its
    13	carrier is allowed a further, independently chosen etale algebra carrying a
    14	prime above it.  The resulting spectra jointly cover the original affine test
    15	scheme.
    16	-/
    17	
    18	set_option autoImplicit false
    19	
    20	universe u
    21	
    22	open CategoryTheory
    23	
    24	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    25	
    26	noncomputable section
    27	
    28	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra
    29	
    30	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
    31	variable (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : T.left.affineOpens)
    32	variable (E : Algebra.EtaleCover Γ(T.left, U.1))
    33	variable (S : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier → Type u)
    34	variable [∀ p, CommRing (S p)] [∀ p, Algebra E.Carrier (S p)]
    35	variable [∀ p, Algebra.Etale E.Carrier (S p)]
    36	
    37	/-- The over-category morphism underlying the member indexed by `p` of the
    38	pointwise prime-lift cover. -/
    39	noncomputable def etalePrimeLiftOverHom
    40	    [∀ p, Algebra k (S p)] [∀ p, IsScalarTower k E.Carrier (S p)]
    41	    (p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier) :
    42	    overSpec k (S p) ⟶ T :=
    43	  Over.overSpecMap (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k E.Carrier (S p)) ≫
    44	    Over.overSpecMap (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k Γ(T.left, U.1) E.Carrier) ≫
    45	      Over.fromSpecAffine T U
    46	
    47	/-- Etale spectra carrying chosen lifts of all primes of a singleton etale
    48	presentation form an etale cover of the original affine-open test object.
    49	
    50	The hypothesis `hU` is the only place affineness of the target is used: it says
    51	that the chosen affine open is the whole target. -/
    52	noncomputable def etalePrimeLiftCover (hU : U.1 = ⊤)
    53	    (q : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier, PrimeSpectrum (S p))
    54	    (hq : ∀ p, PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap E.Carrier (S p)) (q p) = p) :
    55	    T.left.Cover (Scheme.precoverage @Etale) :=
    56	  Scheme.Cover.mkOfCovers (PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier)
    57	    (fun p ↦ Spec (.of (S p)))
    58	    (fun p ↦
    59	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap E.Carrier (S p))) ≫
    60	        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    61	          (algebraMap Γ(T.left, U.1) E.Carrier)) ≫
    62	          (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).left)
    63	    (fun x ↦ by
    64	      have hx : x ∈ Set.range U.2.fromSpec.base := by
    65	        rw [U.2.range_fromSpec, hU]
    66	        trivial
    67	      obtain ⟨xA, hxA⟩ := hx
    68	      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := E.comap_surjective xA
    69	      refine ⟨p, q p, ?_⟩
    70	      change U.2.fromSpec.base
    71	          (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap Γ(T.left, U.1) E.Carrier)
    72	            (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap E.Carrier (S p)) (q p))) = x
    73	      rw [hq p, hp]
    74	      exact hxA)
    75	    (fun p ↦ by
    76	      haveI : Etale
    77	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap E.Carrier (S p)))) := by
    78	        rw [HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)]
    79	        exact RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance
    80	      haveI : Etale
    81	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    82	            (algebraMap Γ(T.left, U.1) E.Carrier))) := by
    83	        rw [HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)]
    84	        exact RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance
    85	      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).left :=
    86	        U.2.isOpenImmersion_fromSpec
    87	      change Etale
    88	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap E.Carrier (S p))) ≫
    89	          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    90	            (algebraMap Γ(T.left, U.1) E.Carrier)) ≫
    91	            (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).left)
    92	      exact MorphismProperty.comp_mem @Etale _ _ inferInstance
    93	        (MorphismProperty.comp_mem @Etale _ _ inferInstance
    94	          (HasRingHomProperty.of_isOpenImmersion
    95	            RingHom.Etale.containsIdentities)))
    96	
    97	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
    98	
    99	/-- Every member morphism of `etalePrimeLiftCover` is definitionally the left
   100	leg of the corresponding over-category composite. -/
   101	@[simp]
   102	theorem etalePrimeLiftCover_f (hU : U.1 = ⊤)
   103	    [∀ p, Algebra k (S p)] [∀ p, IsScalarTower k E.Carrier (S p)]
   104	    (q : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier, PrimeSpectrum (S p))
   105	    (hq : ∀ p, PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap E.Carrier (S p)) (q p) = p)
   106	    (p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier) :
   107	    (etalePrimeLiftCover T U E S hU q hq).f p =
   108	      (etalePrimeLiftOverHom T U E S p).left :=
   109	  rfl
   110	
   111	end
   112	
   113	end AlgebraicGeometry

    43	/-- The chart fixed inside the admissible Abel transformation covers every Pic0 class. -/
    44	theorem chartLocus_admissibleAbelChart_eq_univ

    46	    chartLocus C (admissibleAbelChartIndex C)
    47	      (admissibleAbelChartDivisor C) lam.1 = Set.univ := by
    48	  classical
    49	  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
    50	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
    51	    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
    52	  haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
    53	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
    54	    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)

    67	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_residueField_of_testPointField

    70	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi) (p : PrimeSpectrum B)

    73	    D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField := by

    83	      (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k B) p)).mpr hp

    85	set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
    86	-- Honestification and the full-locus chart elaborate a dependent datum presentation.
    87	/-- An affine Pic0 class admits one etale presentation on whose carrier its admissible twist
    88	is presented by a datum with an H1-vanishing witness at every prime. -/
    89	theorem exists_admissibleAbelDatum_of_affine
    90	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    91	    (lam : pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k A)) :
    92	    ∃ (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A)
    93	      (c : (relCurve C E.Carrier).CechPic)
    94	      (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C E.Carrier (divRepAffP1Map C)),

    96	        ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)

   102	            (chartTwistClass C (admissibleAbelChartIndex C)
   103	              (admissibleAbelChartDivisor C)) ∧
   104	        ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier,
   105	          D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField := by
   106	  classical
   107	  obtain ⟨E, x, hx⟩ : ∃ (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (x : descentClasses C E),

   109	    induction picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1 using PicEtAff.ind with
   110	    | mk E x => exact ⟨E, x, rfl⟩
   111	  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := relPicMk_surjective C (overSpec k E.Carrier)
   112	    (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier))
   113	  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ :=
   114	    exists_datum_cechPicClass_chartTwistClass

   125	            (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) :=
   126	        picEtMap_eq_relPicToPicEt_of_affineRepresentative
   127	          C lam.1 E x hx

   134	        (admissibleAbelChartDivisor C) hD

     8	/-!
     9	# At a one-point test, Zariski-local surjectivity IS surjectivity
    10	
    11	DAT-J's `quasiCompact` field reduces — in either coordinate system, see
    12	`Picard/JacobianDataQcFromRep.lean` and `Picard/Pic0AtlasCompactFromClass.lean` — to one
    13	statement `hcl`: **every point of the representing object has its class pulled back along some
    14	field point of the divisor scheme**.  Both of those files record that `hcl` has no producer,
    15	and the routes they name (the Abel image, finite-separable descent) are the expensive ones.
    16	
    17	This file supplies the general fact that reprices the *first* half of that statement, and it
    18	is not about `pic⁰` at all:
    19	
    20	> a Zariski covering sieve of a scheme whose space is a `Subsingleton` **contains the
    21	> identity**, so a locally surjective morphism of presheaves of types is honestly surjective
    22	> on sections there.
    23	
    24	`Spec K` for a field `K` is such a scheme (`Unique (PrimeSpectrum K)` in mathlib), and the
    25	tests `hcl` quantifies over are exactly `overSpec k κ(y)`.  So on the `hcl` side, coverage —
    26	antecedent 2 of `pic0RepresentableByOfCharts`, which the seam **already assumes** — is not
    27	merely "locally" available at a field point: it gives a section on the nose, with no descent
    28	step and no Abel image.
    29	
    30	## Why the statement is about a `Subsingleton` space and not about fields
    31	
    32	The proof looks at the space only, and it goes through for an arbitrary presheaf of types on
    33	`Scheme`: take a cover refining the sieve (`exists_cover_of_mem_grothendieckTopology`), take
    34	the component over the unique point, observe its base map is epi *because the target has at
    35	most one point*, conclude it is an isomorphism (`IsOpenImmersion.isIso`), and use
    36	`Sieve.downward_closed` along its inverse.  Nothing here mentions `pic⁰`, the curve, the
    37	divisor scheme, or the sheaf condition.  Stated in that generality deliberately: it is the
    38	mirror image of `Picard/Pic0ChartBotRefute.lean`'s
    39	`not_isLocallySurjective_restrictChart_bot_of_presheaf`, which refutes the `V = ⊥` endpoint by
    40	looking only at the *emptiness* of the space.  Empty spaces kill local surjectivity; one-point
    41	spaces make it free.  Both are facts about the site, not about the Picard functor.
    42	
    43	## What this does NOT do, stated because the temptation here is exactly the audited failure mode
    44	
    45	**It does not discharge `hcl`, and it does not discharge any antecedent.**  What it gives is a
    46	section of the Σ-sheaf over `Spec κ(y)` *in the image of the atlas*, i.e. an index `i` and a
    47	`κ(y)`-point of the `i`-th chart source.  `hcl` asks for a point of `divSchemeOver …` whose
    48	class is `pic0Map C q lam` for the **one fixed** class `lam`.  Two gaps remain and neither is
    49	touched here:
    50	
    51	* the chart source of `mixedParamChart` is `(V i : Scheme)`, an *open of* `(D i).left`, and the
    52	  chart index `i` produced is the one coverage happens to supply — so the point obtained lies in
    53	  a chart of the atlas, not in a single named divisor scheme;
    54	* `hcl`'s `lam` is fixed *before* `y` is quantified, whereas coverage's index varies with the
    55	  point.  Collapsing that quantifier order is the real content of `hcl`, and this file leaves
    56	  it open.
    57	
    58	So the honest reading is: **the "local" in DAT-B's local surjectivity costs nothing at the
    59	tests DAT-J quantifies over.**  That is a subtraction from `hcl`'s price, not a payment of it.
    60	
    61	## Main declarations
    62	
    63	* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isIso_of_mem_zariskiTopology` — a covering sieve of a
    64	  `Subsingleton`-space scheme contains an isomorphism.  The only geometric input.
    65	* `AlgebraicGeometry.id_mem_of_mem_zariskiTopology` — hence it contains the identity, i.e. it
    66	  is the top sieve on the nose.
    67	* `AlgebraicGeometry.app_surjective_of_isLocallySurjective_of_subsingleton` — hence local
    68	  surjectivity of an arbitrary morphism of presheaves of types is surjectivity on sections
    69	  there.
    70	* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_chart_section_of_chartsCoverLocally_of_subsingleton` — the `pic⁰`
    71	  reading: at a one-point test, a covering chart family hits **every** section, by a genuine
    72	  index and a genuine point of that chart's source.
    73	-/

    84	/-! ## The site fact -/
    85	
    86	/-- **A Zariski covering sieve of a scheme with at most one point contains an isomorphism.**
    87	
    88	Take a cover refining the sieve; its component over the point `x` is an open immersion whose
    89	base map is surjective *because the target is a subsingleton*, hence an isomorphism.
    90	
    91	The `Subsingleton` hypothesis is on the space, and `x` witnesses that it is also nonempty —
    92	both are needed: on the empty scheme the bottom sieve covers
    93	(`Scheme.bot_mem_grothendieckTopology`) and contains no isomorphism at all. -/
    94	theorem exists_isIso_of_mem_zariskiTopology {X : Scheme.{u}} [Subsingleton (X : Type u)]
    95	    (x : X) (S : Sieve X) (hS : S ∈ Scheme.zariskiTopology X) :
    96	    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X), S.arrows g ∧ IsIso g := by
    97	  obtain ⟨𝒰, hle⟩ := Scheme.exists_cover_of_mem_grothendieckTopology hS
    98	  obtain ⟨i, y, hy⟩ := 𝒰.exists_eq x
    99	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (𝒰.f i) := 𝒰.map_prop i
   100	  haveI : Epi (𝒰.f i).base := by
   101	    rw [TopCat.epi_iff_surjective]
   102	    exact fun z => ⟨y, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
   103	  exact ⟨𝒰.X i, 𝒰.f i, hle _ _ (Presieve.ofArrows.mk i), IsOpenImmersion.isIso (𝒰.f i)⟩
   104	
   105	/-- **A Zariski covering sieve of a scheme with at most one point contains the identity** —
   106	so on such a scheme "covering" carries no information beyond nonemptiness.
   107	
   108	`Sieve.downward_closed` along the inverse of the isomorphism above. -/
   109	theorem id_mem_of_mem_zariskiTopology {X : Scheme.{u}} [Subsingleton (X : Type u)]
   110	    (x : X) (S : Sieve X) (hS : S ∈ Scheme.zariskiTopology X) :
   111	    S.arrows (𝟙 X) := by
   112	  obtain ⟨Y, g, hg, hiso⟩ := exists_isIso_of_mem_zariskiTopology x S hS
   113	  have h := S.downward_closed hg (inv g)
   114	  rwa [IsIso.inv_hom_id] at h
   115	
   116	/-- **Zariski-local surjectivity IS surjectivity at a one-point test.**
   117	
   118	For an arbitrary morphism of presheaves of types on `Scheme`: the image sieve of a section is
   119	covering by hypothesis, hence contains the identity by the previous theorem, and an identity in
   120	the image sieve *is* a preimage of the section.
   121	
   122	No `pic⁰`, no curve, no sheaf condition — this is the counterpart of
   123	`not_isLocallySurjective_restrictChart_bot_of_presheaf`
   124	(`Picard/Pic0ChartBotRefute.lean`), which refutes local surjectivity on the *empty* space by
   125	the same kind of purely site-level argument. -/
   126	theorem app_surjective_of_isLocallySurjective_of_subsingleton
   127	    {F G : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v} (φ : F ⟶ G)
   128	    [Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology φ]
   129	    {X : Scheme.{u}} [Subsingleton (X : Type u)] (x : X) :
   130	    Function.Surjective (φ.app (op X)) := by
   131	  intro s
   132	  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ :=
   133	    id_mem_of_mem_zariskiTopology x _
   134	      (Presheaf.imageSieve_mem Scheme.zariskiTopology φ s)
   135	  exact ⟨t, by simpa using ht⟩
   136

   154	/-! ## The `pic⁰` reading -/
   155	
   156	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   157	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   158	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   159	
   160	/-- **At a one-point test, a covering chart family hits every section on the nose.**
   161	
   162	Given DAT-B's coverage (`ChartsCoverLocally`, the `pic⁰` spelling a producer actually attempts)
   163	and a test whose space has at most one point, every section `s` of the Σ-sheaf over that test
   164	is `f i` applied to a genuine point of the `i`-th chart source — no restriction to a
   165	neighbourhood, no refinement, no descent.
   166	
   167	This is what makes the "local" in B-5/B-6 free at the tests DAT-J's `hcl` quantifies over
   168	(`Picard/JacobianDataQcFromRep.lean`).  It does **not** produce `hcl`: the index `i` here is
   169	whichever one coverage supplies at `s`, while `hcl` fixes one class `lam` on one divisor scheme
   170	before quantifying over points.  See this file's module docstring for the two surviving gaps. -/
   171	theorem exists_chart_section_of_chartsCoverLocally_of_subsingleton {ι : Type u}
   172	    {X : ι → Scheme.{u}} (f : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1)
   173	    (hcov : ChartsCoverLocally C f)
   174	    {T : Scheme.{u}} [Subsingleton (T : Type u)] (t : T)
   175	    (s : (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op T)) :
   176	    ∃ (i : ι) (x : T ⟶ X i), (f i).app (op T) x = s := by
   177	  have hid := id_mem_of_mem_zariskiTopology t _ (hcov T s)
   178	  rw [iSup, Sieve.sSup_apply] at hid
   179	  obtain ⟨S, ⟨i, rfl⟩, x, hx⟩ := hid
   180	  exact ⟨i, x, by simpa using hx⟩
   181	
   182	end AlgebraicGeometry

### loc
    80	
    81	This is dat-b row B-5 verbatim — "every `pic⁰` point is Zariski-locally a chart point" — with
    82	one deliberate design choice: the sieve is described through the individual `f i`, so a
    83	producer discharges it by exhibiting, for each point of `T`, one open neighbourhood and one
    84	index.  It never has to mention `Sigma.desc` or the coproduct of yoneda presheaves.  Turning
    85	that into the coproduct form is `isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc` below. -/
    86	def ChartsCoverLocally {ι : Type u} {X : ι → Scheme.{u}}
    87	    (f : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1) : Prop :=

    31	/-- Every finite subset of a scheme is contained in a single affine open. -/
    32	def FiniteInAffine (X : Scheme.{u}) : Prop :=
    33	  ∀ s : Set X, s.Finite → ∃ U : X.affineOpens, s ⊆ U.1

    35	/-- An affine scheme satisfies `FiniteInAffine`. -/

    40	/-- `FiniteInAffine` is invariant under isomorphism. -/

    47	theorem compactSpace_of_surjective (f : X ⟶ Y) [CompactSpace X]
    48	    (hf : Function.Surjective f.base) : CompactSpace Y :=

    51	/-- **DJ-0, quasi-compactness corollary.** A structure morphism `g : Y ⟶ Z` to an affine

   459	/-! ## §3. The theorem the project was carrying by hand -/
   460	
   461	/-- **A scheme projective over an affine base satisfies `FiniteInAffine`.**
   462

   464	`Scheme.Hom.IsProjective` (`Picard/ProjectiveMorphismBasic.lean`) unfolds to a closed
   465	immersion into `ℙ(n; S)`; a closed immersion is affine (mathlib instance), so §2 pulls
   466	`finiteInAffine_projectiveSpace` back along it.

   468	`FiniteInAffine` is a property of the *underlying scheme*, so the base being affine is
   469	the only hypothesis beyond projectivity — and for the seam the base is `Spec k`, which
   470	is affine. -/

   472	    (h : π.IsProjective) : FiniteInAffine X := by

   478	`FiniteInAffine`.**  Its quasi-compact immersion witness lands in finite relative
   479	projective space; `FiniteInAffine` descends along the underlying immersion.
   480

   482	does not assert an equivalence with general relative ampleness over arbitrary
   483	bases. -/
   484	theorem finiteInAffine_of_isHQuasiProjective {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S]
   485	    {π : X ⟶ S} (h : π.IsHQuasiProjective) : FiniteInAffine X := by
   486	  obtain ⟨n, hn, i, hi, _, -⟩ := h
   487	  letI : Finite n := hn
   488	  haveI : IsImmersion i := hi
   489	  exact finiteInAffine_of_isImmersion i (finiteInAffine_projectiveSpace n S)

   492	`finiteInAffine_of_isHQuasiProjective`. -/

   494	    {π : X ⟶ S} {L : X.Modules} (h : π.IsHQuasiProjectiveWith L) :

### tail

   688	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) {ι : Type v} [Infinite ι]
   689	    (U : ι → Set X.left) (hopen : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) (hne : ∀ i, (U i).Nonempty)
   690	    (hdisj : _root_.Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint U))

   713	orbit lands in **one** piece, which is degree-invariance of the action, and the

   776	coproducts: a finite set meets only finitely many components, each hit in an affine open,

mcp__lean_lsp__lean_diagnostic_messages: ## General Rules
- All line and column numbers are 1-indexed. Columns count characters (codepoints).
- This MCP does NOT edit files. Use other tools for editing.

## Key Tools
- **lean_goal**: Proof state at position. Omit `column` for before/after. `status` field: 'goals', 'complete' (proof done here), or 'no_goal_at_position' (not inside a proof).
- **lean_diagnostic_messages**: Compiler errors/warnings. "no goals to be solved" = remove tactics.
- **lean_term_goal**: Expected type at a position.
- **lean_hover_info**: Type signature + docs. Column at START of identifier.
- **lean_completions**: IDE autocomplete on incomplete code.
- **lean_local_search**: Fast local declaration search. Use BEFORE trying a lemma name.
- **lean_file_outline**: Token-efficient file skeleton (slow-ish).
- **lean_multi_attempt**: Test tactics without editing at a proof position. Use `column` for an exact source position; omit it for fast line-based attempts: `["simp", "ring", "omega"]`

theorem test_surjective_of_isLocallySurjective_yoneda_map
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (h : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.etaleTopology (yoneda.map f)) :
    Function.Surjective f.base := by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨𝒰, hle⟩ := Scheme.mem_grothendieckTopology_iff.mp
    (h.imageSieve_mem (Y.fromSpecResidueField y))
  obtain ⟨i, z, hz⟩ :=
    𝒰.exists_eq (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (Y.residueField y))
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hle (𝒰.X i) (𝒰.f i) (Presieve.ofArrows.mk i)
  refine ⟨q.base z, ?_⟩
  have heq := congrArg (fun m : 𝒰.X i ⟶ Y => m.base z) hq
  simpa only [yoneda_map_app_apply, yoneda_obj_map_apply, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
    hz, Scheme.fromSpecResidueField_apply] using heq

end AlgebraicGeometry
